chunks: Have We not opened up your breast
ai.seo_question: What does the expansion of the Prophet's breast signify in Surah Al-Sharh?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as the initial stage of 'Tawhid al-Af'al' (Unity of Actions), where Allah purified the Prophet's heart to become a perfect vessel for divine revelation and guidance. This expansion signifies not only the removal of spiritual anxiety but also the granting of the capacity to bear the heavy responsibilities of leadership (Imamah) and conveying the message to humanity.
